parameters.name: ExecutionIds
parameters.description: The execution IDs. The value is a JSON array of IDs in the format of `["xxxxxxxxx", "yyyyyyyyy", … "zzzzzzzzz"]`. A maximum of 100 IDs are supported. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description: Specifies whether to force delete a task that is being executed. Default value: false.
